text: Fork package clone onto computer. haven’t done , recommend using usethis::create_from_github("reichlab/alloscore2", fork = TRUE). what: Add list columns of p/d/q/r functions to a forecast data frame — add_pdqr_funs
title: Add list columns of p/d/q/r functions to a forecast data frame — add_pdqr_funs
text: Given data frame one row per target, dist column (dist argument) naming distribution, columns distribution's parameters, adds list columns holding corresponding cdf, density, quantile function /random generator. allocate() needs cdf ("p") quantile function ("q").

title: Add list columns of p/d/q/r functions to a forecast data frame — add_pdqr_funs
code: add_pdqr_funs(   df,   dist = df$dist,   trans = NULL,   trans_inv = NULL,   transpars = NULL,   types = c("p", "d", "q", "r"),   fnames = c(p = "F", d = "f", q = "Q", r = "r") )

title: Add list columns of p/d/q/r functions to a forecast data frame — add_pdqr_funs
text: df data frame one row per target. must column parameter required distribution functions named dist column dist argument. dist character vector length 1 nrow(df) giving distribution root names ("distfromq"); required df dist column. trans function outcome x parameters, pre-composed p d functions. Use distributions whose support must rescaled, beta distribution [x_min, x_max]. trans_inv inverse trans, post-composed q r functions. transpars parameters trans trans_inv columns df. types "p", "d", "q", "r" add. fnames names give added list columns.

title: Add list columns of p/d/q/r functions to a forecast data frame — add_pdqr_funs
text: tibble requested list columns added.

title: Add list columns of p/d/q/r functions to a forecast data frame — add_pdqr_funs
code: fc <- add_pdqr_funs(   tibble::tibble(     target_names = c("a", "b"),     dist = "norm",     mean = c(5, 8),     sd = c(1, 2)   ),   types = c("p", "q") ) fc$F[[1]](5) #> [1] 0.5

what: Allocate a budget to minimize expected gpl loss — allocate
title: Allocate a budget to minimize expected gpl loss — allocate
text: Solves $$\min_x \sum_i E_{Y_i \sim F_i} L_i(x_i, Y_i)       \quad\text{subject }\quad \sum_i w_i x_i \le K,\ x_i \ge 0,$$ \(L_i\) generalized piecewise linear loss (see gpl_loss_fun()). problem separable convex, optimum marginal expected benefit \(\Lambda_i\) (see meb_gpl_df()) equal across targets receiving positive allocation. allocate() bisects common value \(\lambda\), inverting \(\Lambda_i\) target step. values K solved simultaneously, sharing root-finding work wherever currently agree \(\lambda\).

title: Allocate a budget to minimize expected gpl loss — allocate
code: allocate(   df = NULL,   K,   target_names = NA,   F = NULL,   Q = NULL,   w = 1,   kappa = 1,   alpha = 1,   g = "x",   dg = NA,   eps_lam = 1e-04,   eps_K = 0.01,   point_mass_window = 0.001 )

title: Allocate a budget to minimize expected gpl loss — allocate
text: df data frame one row per target. Columns df supply arguments: argument left empty filled like-named column, argument whose value length-1 string naming column df replaced column, w = "c" uses c column weights. K vector budgets. supplied via df. target_names names allocation targets, name column df holding . Defaults row indices. F list predictive cdfs, one per target. Q list predictive quantile functions, one per target. w numeric vector costs per unit resource allocated target. kappa scale factor. alpha normalized loss outcome y exceeds allocation x. Exactly one alpha U must supplied. g non-decreasing increment function, supplied either function string variable x "log(x)". dg derivative increment function g. NA, g differentiated symbolically stats::D(). eps_lam relative tolerance terminating bisection lambda. eps_K relative tolerance budget, post-processing attempted. point_mass_window distance search intervals widened order catch point masses Fs, intended otherwise.

title: Allocate a budget to minimize expected gpl loss — allocate
text: tibble class allocated, one row per value K columns K budget. x list named allocation vectors. xs list data frames holding allocation iteration. qs_OK whether unconstrained (quantile) solution already satisfied budget. lam, lamL, lamU final Lagrange multiplier bracketing interval, *_seq columns holding full iteration history. post_processed whether plateau post-processing applied. xdf list per-target tibbles holding allocation scoring function. gpl_df, w target_col_name attributes carry loss functions, weights target column name.

title: Allocate a budget to minimize expected gpl loss — allocate
code: fc <- add_pdqr_funs(   tibble::tibble(     target_names = c("a", "b", "c"),     dist = "norm",     mean = c(5, 8, 12),     sd = c(1, 2, 3)   ),   types = c("p", "q") ) a <- allocate(fc, K = c(10, 20), alpha = 0.9) a$xdf[[1]] #> # A tibble: 3 × 3 #>   target_names     x score_fun #>   <chr>        <dbl> <list>    #> 1 a             2.50 <fn>      #> 2 b             3.00 <fn>      #> 3 c             4.50 <fn>

what: Score allocations against realized outcomes — alloscore
title: Score allocations against realized outcomes — alloscore
text: Allocates budget set forecasts scores realized gpl loss allocation, optionally relative loss oracle knew outcomes advance. oracle-relative score non-negative zero perfect forecast.

title: Score allocations against realized outcomes — alloscore
code: alloscore(df = NULL, ...)  # Default S3 method alloscore(   df = NULL,   K,   target_names = NA,   y,   F = NULL,   Q = NULL,   w = 1,   kappa = 1,   alpha = 1,   g = "x",   dg = NA,   eps_K = 0.01,   eps_lam = 1e-04,   against_oracle = TRUE,   slim = FALSE,   ... )  # S3 method for class 'allocated' alloscore(df, y, against_oracle = TRUE, ...)  # S3 method for class 'slim' alloscore(df, ys, against_oracle = TRUE, ...)

title: Score allocations against realized outcomes — alloscore
text: df data frame forecasts, allocated object (returned allocate()), slim object (returned slim()). method dispatched determines arguments apply. ... arguments passed methods. K vector budgets. supplied via df. target_names names allocation targets, name column df holding . Defaults row indices. y numeric vector observed outcomes, one per target. F list predictive cdfs, one per target. Q list predictive quantile functions, one per target. w numeric vector costs per unit resource allocated target. kappa scale factor. alpha normalized loss outcome y exceeds allocation x. Exactly one alpha U must supplied. g non-decreasing increment function, supplied either function string variable x "log(x)". dg derivative increment function g. NA, g differentiated symbolically stats::D(). eps_K relative tolerance budget, post-processing attempted. eps_lam relative tolerance terminating bisection lambda. against_oracle logical; TRUE, components scores relative oracle allocation included. slim logical; TRUE, drop heavy list columns scoring. See slim(). ys list named outcome vectors, whose names must match target names df.

title: Score allocations against realized outcomes — alloscore
text: tibble form returned allocate(), class scored prepended additional columns components_raw realized gpl loss target (inside xdf). score_raw sum components_raw. components_oracle oracle's loss target (inside xdf). score_oracle sum components_oracle. components components_raw - components_oracle (inside xdf). score score_raw - score_oracle. ytot total weighted outcome, sum(w * y).

title: Score allocations against realized outcomes — alloscore
text: alloscore(default): Allocates scores, forecasts supplied data frame individual arguments. alloscore(allocated): Scores allocation already computed. alloscore(slim): Scores slim allocation many outcome vectors, Monte Carlo work. Uses oracle_alloscore_direct() rather full oracle allocation.

what: Create a generalized piecewise linear (gpl) loss function — gpl_loss_fun
title: Create a generalized piecewise linear (gpl) loss function — gpl_loss_fun
text: gpl loss allocation x outcome y $$L(x, y) = \kappa[(1 - \alpha)(g(x) - g(y))_+ + \alpha (g(y) - g(x))_+] + \mathrm{offset}(y).$$ g(x) = x pinball (quantile) loss level alpha, scaled kappa. Despite name need piecewise linear, since g may non-decreasing increment function.

title: Create a generalized piecewise linear (gpl) loss function — gpl_loss_fun
code: gpl_loss_fun(g = "x", kappa = 1, alpha = NA, O = NA, U = NA, offset = 0)

title: Create a generalized piecewise linear (gpl) loss function — gpl_loss_fun
text: g non-decreasing increment function, supplied either function string variable x "log(x)". kappa scale factor. alpha normalized loss outcome y exceeds allocation x. Exactly one alpha U must supplied. O cost incurred allocation x exceeds outcome y; equals kappa * (1 - alpha). U cost incurred outcome y exceeds allocation x; equals kappa * alpha. offset constant, function y, added loss. default 0 gives loss L(x, x) = 0.

title: Create a generalized piecewise linear (gpl) loss function — gpl_loss_fun
text: function allocation x outcome y giving loss.

title: Create a generalized piecewise linear (gpl) loss function — gpl_loss_fun
